description: This PHP source file manages the saving of user-selected default widgets for the home page in the vtiger CRM system. It processes incoming JSON data, decodes it, and updates database tables to reflect the user's widget preferences.

classes.name: HomeDefaultWidgets
classes.description: A class containing static methods to handle saving user widget preferences on the home page.

methods.name: saveSelected
methods.description: Saves the user-selected home page widgets into the database, updating visibility based on the selection.
